test_a_changed_ledger_keeps_archive_memb: Fail if changed tool_steps is not 19, updated detail is not preserved, durable row count is not the reduced fixture count, deleted final id remains readable, or refreshed rows become hot.
test_a_default_sweep_moves_exactly_its_b: Independent literal population 2003 must yield 2000 retired and 3 hot, then 3 retired and zero hot; removing cap yields the recorded red 2003!=2000.
test_a_dry_sweep_and_a_recent_or_undated: Fail if dry run removes any of the 26 rows, or applied sweep removes recent/undated rows or retains other rows.
test_a_failed_archive_copy_leaves_both_h: The explicit aborting detail trigger must raise IntegrityError; fail if archive runs commit, hot detail count drops, retired membership commits or any original hot id is lost. Removing copy/delete transactionality breaks rollback assertions.
test_a_run_something_can_still_need_stay: For each live/review/queue/review-owed case, fail if the protected id leaves or any unprotected id remains; review-owed also fails if a committed review does not release the row. Removing the corresponding protection reddens the membership assertion.
test_a_store_needing_conversion_is_not_r: Fail if unprepared store does not report maintenance, fails to retire its one old row, changes auto_vacuum from 0 or loses its freelist during sweep; explicit command must return mode 0->2 and rewritten true, repeat must return false, history must preserve tool_steps=7, and later sweep must report no maintenance.
test_an_import_racing_retirement_does_no: Events must reach membership inspection and release within their bounds; fail if preserved tool_steps is lost or any run is hot after serialized retirement. Restoring membership selection before BEGIN IMMEDIATE allows the documented recreated-hot-row race.
test_an_unneeded_run_leaves_hot_tables_a: Fail if retirement leaves any hot run or detail, fails to shrink total hot-file page_count, loses tool_steps=7 or fixture detail, exposes archived runs through records(), loses durable row count, loses ledger rows or derived wall_seconds=60, or rehydrates on read. Disabling retirement reproduces the recorded base failure.
test_import_and_membership_checks_do_not: Fail if import is not unchanged for all fixture records, recreates any hot run/detail, reports index lag, loses the node-keyed tool_steps=7, reports file-only membership, attaches the archive for warm records(), exposes hot records, or accepts appending an archived key. Removing retired membership routing makes these fail.
test_incremental_compaction_continues_af: Fail if first pass does not retire 24, second retires anything, or either pass has page reduction outside 1..3; requiring candidates for compaction fails the second page-delta assertion.
test_the_command_configures_both_row_and: Fail if CLI fails, reported row/page budgets differ from 7/3, actual retirement differs from 7 with 17 hot, or measured page reduction is outside 1..3. Budget echoes alone are weak, but independent SQL population counts and page deltas make this a behavioral guard.
test_the_hourly_sweep_uses_incremental_c: SQL trace must contain incremental_vacuum and no VACUUM statement; restoring VACUUM main produces the recorded failure.
test_unbounded_store_budgets_are_refused: Zero row budget and zero page budget must raise ValueError with positive-limit message and leave all rows hot; allowing SQLite zero-page vacuum or unlimited row selection breaks the refusal assertion.

assertion_independence: No assertion compares a returned value with itself. Detail round trips compare persisted reads against fixture content and fail on a dropped or corrupted copy; budget metadata assertions are corroborated by independent SQLite counts and page measurements. Ledger and velocity checks read committed ledger data, while separate get_run/get_detail/durable_rows checks directly exercise archive reads.
